headline: Inside the S&P 500 AI boom, industrials are getting as rich as tech stocks
summary: The industrials sector of the stock market is benefitting from the AI infrastructure boom with its P/E ratio up close to tech levels and investor flows strong.

headline: The Iran War Is Creating Winners and Losers: Lockheed Martin (LMT) vs. American Airlines (AAL)
summary: American Airlines Group Inc. (NASDAQ:AAL) and Lockheed Martin Corporation (NYSE:LMT) Corporation (NYSE:LMT) both reported earnings the same day this week.
